title: About
heading: About Me!
intro: A little more about the person behind this homepage.
content:
## Who am I?

Hey! I'm Amitendu Bikash Dhusiya, a BCA student at [Techno India Hooghly Campus](https://www.technoindiahooghly.org/) and which is affiliated with [M.A.K.A.U.T.](https://www.makautwb.ac.in/)

I'm interested in building things with code, exploring new technologies, and figuring out how software works behind the scenes. I enjoy turning ideas into practical applications, experimenting with different tools, and learning something new with every project.

## What I Do

My interests span several areas of development, including [Software Development](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Software_development), [Web Development](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Web_development), and [Backend Development](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/blogs/backend-development/). I work with technologies such as [Java](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Java_(programming_language)), [Python](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Python_(programming_language)), [C Programming](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/C_(programming_language)), [JavaScript](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/JavaScript), [React](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/React_(software)), [Angular](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Angular_(web_framework)), [Spring Boot](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spring_Boot), and [SQL](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SQL).

I'm also interested in [Full-stack Development](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/blogs/what-is-full-stack-development/), [Cloud Computing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cloud_computing), and [Machine Learning](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Machine_learning). I'm always looking for opportunities to expand my knowledge, build useful projects, and improve my problem-solving skills.

## Beyond Coding

There's more to me than just code.

* Gaming: I'm a fan of *[HoYoverse](https://www.hoyoverse.com/en-us/)* games, especially *[Genshin Impact](https://genshin.hoyoverse.com/en/home)*, *[Honkai: Star Rail](https://hsr.hoyoverse.com/en-us/home)*, and *[Zenless Zone Zero](https://zenless.hoyoverse.com/en-us/main)*.
* Anime: I enjoy watching *[Anime](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anime)* in my free time.
* PC Hardware: I'm interested in PC Building and Computer Hardware, from components and configurations to understanding how everything works together.
* Design: I enjoy exploring [UI/UX Design](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/difference-between-ui-and-ux/) and how thoughtful design can make software more intuitive and enjoyable to use.
* Other interests: I enjoy playing *[Carrom](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carrom)* and reading.

I also occasionally *[stream on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@ShadowAmitendu)*, usually as a way to share my gaming interests.

## What I'm Working Towards

I'm exploring different areas of technology to figure out where I can make the most impact. My current interests include:

* Building reliable, maintainable software through [Software Engineering](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Software_engineering).
* Developing complete applications through [Full-stack Development](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/blogs/what-is-full-stack-development/).
* Learning how scalable applications and infrastructure work through [Cloud Computing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cloud_computing).
* Exploring data-driven applications through [Machine Learning](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Machine_learning).

## My Approach

I believe in [Learning by Doing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Learning-by-doing). For me, the best way to understand a technology is to experiment with it, build something, run into problems, and work through them.

This website is my little corner of the internet where I share my projects, document my interests, and keep track of my journey as a developer.

Feel free to explore the site, or visit my *[GitHub](https://github.com/ShadowAmitendu)* to see what I'm working on.

Thanks for stopping by, stranger!
